faq.title: Everything you need to know about Dentiqly

items.question: How long does it take to set up Dentiqly?
items.answer: Less than 10 minutes. Sign up, create your clinic, and you're ready to add patients, configure services, and schedule appointments. No installation or technical support needed.

items.question: Can I manage multiple locations from one account?
items.answer: Yes. Dentiqly is natively multi-location. From a single dashboard you can view metrics, schedule appointments, and manage professionals across all your clinics in real time.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use AES-256 encryption, SSL/TLS connections, and automatic hourly backups. Each clinic's data is fully isolated in a secure multi-tenant architecture.

items.question: How do automated reminders work?
items.answer: Dentiqly sends automatic email reminders to your patients before each appointment. You can customize the message and timing. This reduces no-shows by up to 40%.

items.question: Can I migrate data from another system?
items.answer: Yes. We offer free assisted migration of patients, histories, and appointments from Excel spreadsheets or other systems. Our team guides you through the entire process at no extra cost.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. You get a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to get started.
